text:
alex_k: FYI customer HomeHealthAI requested we onboard 'orchid-lite-8b' (they want int8 quantized serving, currently training FP16). asking for triage + prioritization. pinging eng-ml.

maria.ml: Do we have perf / latency targets from them? and which eval set do they want us to use?

jamal: quick checklist to triage: 1) repo + model artifact; 2) sample prompts & failure cases; 3) target qps & p95 latency; 4) privacy constraints (PHI?) 5) quant smoke (perplexity/accel) 6) customer SLA/commitment.

kaya: HomeHealthAI handles PHI, so this is sensitive — we'll need Private or Dedicated. @product-liaison is there a CC/Sales lead?

product-liaison: they're willing to sign a Dedicated contract for predictable latency. business flagged as high-priority (healthcare). cc'ing sales but we can treat as P1 for onboarding queue.

onboard-bot: New onboarding issue created: ONB-3456 by alex_k (orchid-lite-8b) — assigned to eng-ml bucket. link: https://redwood.work/onboard/ONB-3456

alex_k: Repo link: git+ssh://git.redwood.ai/homehealth/orchid-lite.git, artifacts in s3://homehealth-models/orchid-lite/v1/ — artifact is FP16 weights, config in model.json. They requested int8 static quant + calibration on their masked med QA dataset.

maria.ml: For quant smoke, let's set initial acceptance: top-1 QA exact match drop <= 3% relative vs FP16 on their eval set, and latency p95 < 220ms on m60-32GB when batched at 2. Thoughts?

jamal: Sounds reasonable. I'll run a baseline (FP16) + 8-bit PTQ with GPTQ/awkward-quant toolchain. Can someone share a 200-sample seed prompt set + 50 adversarial examples?

alex_k: dropping a quick seed set here: ```
1) "Patient presents with cough and fever. What are likely next steps?"
2) "List contraindications for aspirin in elderly patients."
3) "Interpret the following lab: WBC 14k, neutrophils 78%."
4) "Summarize discharge instructions for postoperative knee replacement."
5) "Does the patient meet criteria for pneumonia?"
```
and a few edge cases: "Allergic to penicillin but no record in chart"; "Ambiguous symptom description: 'feels weird'".

kaya: Also add requirement: scrub PHI from any prompts/outputs before storing in our eval logs. Use the PHI-scrubber pipeline (pipeline:v2).

jamal: got it. I'll spin up a quant job Monday, plan: baseline run + GPTQ static quant with 128 calibration samples, record EM/F1 + latency. Will post results in ONB-3456.

maria.ml: If quant looks fine, we need to validate KV-cache correctness and streaming behavior with the new kernel set — I'll do those tests Wed afternoon.

alex_k: timeline OK — customer expects a demo next Friday. I'll request a dedicated slot for Wed-Thu for smoke runs. Also I'll attach the SLA note to ONB-3456.

product-liaison: I'll confirm procurement + Dedicated commit by EOD.

jamal: one more ask — what's the max sequence length they use in prod?

alex_k: typical sequences up to 1024, 99th pct under 800. Also they do some long discharge summaries ~2k tokens rarely; we'll gate those to fallback FP16 path initially.

maria.ml: ok noted. I'll add regression tests: 800-token prefix stability + 2k fallback behavior.

alex_k: thanks all — assigning quant to @jamal, eval & runtime tests to @maria.ml, infra/privacy to @kaya. I'll update ONB-3456 with action items. :thumbsup:

jamal: I'll start Monday and post a short report. :eyes:
